newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong, Philippines air dispute talks restarted.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong, Philippines air dispute talks restarted.

text.p: More talks are being held to try and finally reach a deal on a new air service agreement between Hong Kong and the Philippines, the Hong Kong government has confirmed.
It is the last agreement still to be finalised before Hong Kong is handed over to China next July but the previous rounds in February and August both broke down in deadlock.
The first of two days of talks were held in Hong Kong today, but the government spokeswoman declined to give further details on their progress.
A leading member of the Philippines panel recently blamed the breakdown on flag carrier Philippine Airlines demanding fifth freedom rights out of Hong Kong. Philippine Airlines declined to comment.
Benjamin Solis, Managing Director of Philippines cargo carrier Pacific East Asia Cargo Airlines also told Reuters that he expects an agreement will be signed during the next two days of talks.
